LITERACY ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Imitation without checking.
   B. Treat Imitation as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Use Imitation to shame classmates.
   D. Apply Imitation with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.

2. Which option best shows correct understanding of Reading comprehension? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Reading comprehension without checking.

7. Which option best shows correct understanding of Story Telling? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Story Telling as empty slogans with no facts.
   B. Apply Story Telling with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   C. Use Story Telling to shame classmates.
   D. Copy a rumour about Story Telling without checking.

8. Which option best shows correct understanding of Presentation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply Presentation with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   B. Treat Presentation as empty slogans with no facts.

9. Which option best shows correct understanding of Effective? (1 mark)
   A. Use Effective to shame classmates.
   B. Apply Effective with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.

10. Which option best shows correct understanding of Handwriting? (1 mark)

   A. Use Talk about to shame classmates.

   C. Treat Talk about as empty slogans with no facts.
   D. Copy a rumour about Talk about without checking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Independent reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sentence formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
